completion_data.completion_summary: Added 9 ephemeral-orchestration-state patterns to the repo-root .gitignore and untracked 202 currently-tracked matches via git rm --cached (index-only, working tree fully preserved), verified across three phases with no regressions to durable artifacts or the in-flight sibling batch.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan asserts an exact live-derived count (e.g. 'manifest must be exactly N') and concurrent sibling tasks are actively committing during execution, treat the count as a live invariant to re-verify, not a frozen constant: re-derive it, diff the delta against the expected pattern categories, and proceed only if every added/removed item matches an already-intended category (no unexpected new category). This is the correct response to legitimate concurrent drift, distinct from a hard-stop-worthy anomaly (e.g. an unrelated durable file appearing in the manifest).

For a git-workflow gitignore-and-untrack task under a postflight that runs a pathspec-less 'git commit' (commits the entire index), the safe pattern is: stage exactly the intended paths, assert 'git diff --cached --name-only' matches expectations exactly, commit immediately, and never let the phase end with anything staged. This keeps a concurrent sibling task's own postflight commit from silently sweeping in unrelated staged content. Verified live across a 2-commit sequence (.gitignore-only commit, then a 202-file git-rm --cached commit) with zero cross-contamination.
